claims.claim: Direct Belgium Gearbox ford Expedition V8 4WD
claims.evidence: No readable Ford/Expedition identification, no visible part number/label, and no clear markings in the photos to confirm vehicle fitment or origin.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/fitment (e.g., not the correct Expedition V8 4WD variant, or not the correct gear ratio/transfer case pairing).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID tag/plate or stamped part number on the casing (close-up, well-lit), plus the VIN/engine code of the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gearbox with uncertain fitment (worst case: may not bolt up / may not match transfer case).

risks.risk: Condition unknown (may be non-functional, slipping, or damaged internally).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (bench test or installed test) showing engagement and no abnormal noises, or a receipt/record of testing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: treated as faulty/needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete harness/solenoids (external parts may be missing or damaged).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: underside and all connectors/ports, including a close-up of every connector and any missing-looking plugs; also show the full harness end-to-end.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: may require parts replacement).

risks.risk: Fluid contamination/leaks (seal failure, cracked housing, or internal leak).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the casing seams, pan area, and any wet/oily spots; plus a pressure/visual leak check video.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as leaking/unknown (worst case: requires reseal).

risks.risk: Shipping/origin claim ("Belgium") may be marketing; could be re-sold without documentation.
risks.proof: Any import document, receipt, or label showing origin; or a photo of the shipping crate/waybill.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without origin premium (worst case: no documentation).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the transmission ID tag/label and any stamped part numbers on the casing (both sides).
Photo of the connector types/locations and the full wiring harness ends (to confirm it matches the vehicle).
Video proof of operation (engagement through gears) or a test report from installation/testing.
Photos of the pan/underside and all seals/ports to confirm no leaks and completeness.
response.reason: The photos show a used gearbox assembly, but there is no readable ID/part number or clear evidence confirming it matches Ford Expedition V8 4WD or that it works. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be confidently set.
